fact: Décret n° 2024-071/PR of 26 December 2024 requires telecom operators to record the ANID-issued NIU of every national and resident subscriber at SIM registration and to see the ANID identification card, giving existing operators 12 months from signature to comply; the text states no query of ANID's database.
system: Identification systématique et obligatoire des abonnés (SIM registration)

fact: ARCEP Togo's page describes a certification authority that accredits trust service providers and auditors and publishes an official trust list.

ARCEP Togo's trust list shows three trust service providers (Axendit Togo, Augura Technologies Togo, Chronoservices International) accredited on 19 February 2026 for three years, with no qualified auditor yet.

The National Identification Agency's deck says OTP authentication on the unique identification number is fully deployed and actively used, including through the digital one-stop portal for public services.
The deck says ANID serves as identity service provider to banks and financial institutions for e-KYC and to public services, with verification by QR code, remote API, mobile app and USSD.
